intervals.quote: Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) was established in 1943 to conduct scientific research for the Manhattan Project.

name: Los Alamos National Laboratory
notes: The neutrino-oscillations topic is attached because LANSCE (as LAMPF) produced the neutrino beam for the LSND experiment.

operator_text.quote: Managed by Triad National Security, LLC for the U.S. Dept. of Energy's NNSA
operator_text.value: Triad National Security, LLC for the U.S. Department of Energy's National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA)

summary.plain: A United States national laboratory in the mountains of New Mexico, founded during the Manhattan Project. Its LANSCE accelerator produces intense beams of protons and neutrons used for nuclear and particle physics, including past neutrino experiments.
summary.technical: DOE/NNSA national laboratory (Los Alamos, New Mexico), managed by Triad National Security, LLC; operates the LANSCE proton linac (Technical Area 53), historically LAMPF, whose beam-stop neutrinos fed the LSND experiment.
